topic: Granting GitHub access and repository permissions
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on granting necessary access to a new Data Scientist/Analyst (Lucas Silva) for company repositories. Initially, there was confusion regarding GitHub access and who had the authority to grant it.

It was established that [p3] would handle issuing the required access. Several participants noted that Lucas has not yet been granted full repository access or deployment rights for the ml-api, despite being a new team member.
decisions: [p3] will issue GitHub access/invites to the new Data Scientist/Analyst.
